scope: Local source, unit, Worker/D1 fixture, and web build verification for channel-neutral SIM/eSIM offer-specific initial Sky Agent pack resolution plus owner entitlement-aware Marketplace and Stripe checkout purchase suppression.

implemented.configuration: Optional ROCKSTAR_SERVICE_OFFER_PROFILES maps signed issuerId + offerId to profileId/version/label and exact Sky packageKey/manifestSha256 pins.
implemented.resolution: Only uniquely registered packages with verified review state, installable status, exact package key, exact stored hash, and recomputed manifest hash are presented as ready.
implemented.owner_control: Profile activation is owner_choice_required; claim redemption does not install packages, execute tools, or authorize paid work.
surfaces: Android Shell service entitlement display source
Offer-package deep link from the claim onboarding screen to the exact Sky Marketplace package detail
Fail-closed deep-link state when the package is absent from the current reviewed registry or the registry cannot be read
Owner-scoped active entitlement read suppresses duplicate standalone Marketplace purchase for an included package; lookup pending/unavailable blocks purchase
Included offer pricing is distinguished from standalone package price, and the CTA routes to Sky connection settings without claiming the selected agent is already runnable in Zema

Authenticated Stripe checkout API rechecks active owner claim, offer profile, and exact currently reviewed package before creating or reusing checkout state; included packages return 409, malformed mapping returns 503, expired/revoked claims do not suppress legitimate checkout

tests.coverage: Offer-to-profile mapping, exact hash review checks, explicit owner choice, onboarding-to-exact-package deep-link source contract, fail-closed stale/unavailable registry behavior, and Marketplace purchase suppression only for active ready included profiles.

databaseCounts.note: Stale regression constants were updated to match current generated database status; production state remains unverified.

focusedAfterDeepLinkChange.typecheck: npm run typecheck passed before removal of an unused local only
focusedAfterDeepLinkChange.webBuild: npm run build passed after all deep-link changes

fixtureCoverage: Different signed offers resolve to different versioned starter pack profiles.
Unreviewed fixture package remains unavailable while the underlying entitlement stays valid.
Exact reviewed synthetic package hash resolves as ready with owner choice required.
Stale hash, malformed configuration, and unconfigured offers fail closed.
Active included Package blocks direct API checkout before a Stripe session or order is created.
Expired and revoked service claims allow otherwise valid standalone purchase.
Malformed offer profile configuration fails closed before Stripe.
A ready exact Package remains protected from duplicate checkout when another package in its profile needs review.
not_proven: Real Healthcare/Lifeline or Developer package availability, safety review, or suitability.
Production configuration, seller checkout, SIM/eSIM purchase, or carrier activation.
Package installation or tool execution on an Android device or RockstarOS image.
Package-specific runtime authorization or successful Zema execution from the Marketplace offer link.
Production cloud billing, provider usage, production D1, or user invoice.
Production seller checkout or Stripe charge, production carrier activation, provider runtime authorization, or package-to-Zema task handoff.
boundary: Synthetic registry rows and local usage/test records are implementation evidence only; they are not production billing, carrier activation, or successful OS installation.
